verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Kong Gateway primarily as a reverse proxy/API gateway for RESTful APIs and AI/LLM traffic (e.g., 'Kong Gateway runs in front of any RESTful API' and various AI Gateway/A2A/MCP proxying features), but there is no mention anywhere of GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, or SSE request handling. missing for 10: any documentation or example of GraphQL support, gRPC proxying, WebSocket routing, or SSE request handling.
